editorial.blurb: This tiny Edgewater gem serves massive, freshly made huaraches that are pure comfort—owner Blanca and her team treat every customer like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a huarache as your main; one massive corn tortilla stuffed with beans and your choice of topping (chicken tinga, carne asada, or nopales are all winners) will absolutely fill you up, and arrive early to snag one of the five tables.
